ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a figure 'followed a road' in Quranic commentary?
ai.summary: In Shia exegetical tradition, this phrase from Surah Al-Kahf (18:60) describes Musa (AS) pursuing Khidr after the latter departed in haste, illustrating the dynamic between the seeker of hidden knowledge and the divine guide. It underscores the necessity of following a qualified teacher (Ustadh) to uncover the 'batin' (inner reality) behind the 'zahir' (outer appearance) of events. This pursuit marks the beginning of the narrative where Musa learns that divine wisdom often transcends immediate human understanding.
